title: The archived simulator prices with the column-to-the-left chain
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new archived tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, archived, on Same as previous tier in matrix A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, one range, Default 50% markup.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click Edit on matrix A's row.
  4. Type 100 in the Price Part Simulator's Part Cost.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A shows among the archived rows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The archived view shows Default and tier A; tier A reads Uses previous tier.

Step 4:

  • Default shows $150.00 ($100.00 × 1.50) and tier A shows $150.00, the same as Default, its column to the left.
